overview: A U.S Customs official uncovers a massive money laundering scheme involving Pablo Escobar.
tagline: The true story of one man against the biggest drug cartel in history.

recs.blurb: A three-tiered story centered around drugs and organized crime, and focused on a young man who becomes a runner for a coke dealer.
Two aspiring boxers lifelong friends get involved in a money-laundering scheme through a low-level organized crime group.
An Argentinian crime drama revolving around a sheet of rare stamps (the Nine Queens).
Two brothers, on either side of the law, face off over organized crime in Brooklyn during the 1970s.
A pregnant Colombian teenager becomes a drug mule to make some desperately needed money for her family.
Set in Brazil, three kids who make a discovery in a garbage dump soon find themselves running from the cops and trying to right a terrible wrong.
Pot growers Ben and Chon face off against the Mexican drug cartel who kidnapped their shared girlfriend.
